old: counted in Neurons, a GPU-compute billing unit priced at USD 0.011 per 1,000 above the allocation; credits is the nearest vocabulary term
new: counted in Neurons, Cloudflare's way of measuring AI outputs across models by the GPU compute a request needs; Workers Paid bills usage above the allocation at USD 0.011 per 1,000 Neurons. What one Neuron buys differs by model: bge-reranker-base is priced at 283 neurons per M input tokens. Prepaid AI Gateway credits can also pay for Workers AI inference and are not the unit of this allowance

evidence.proved: a Neuron is Cloudflare's own measure of the GPU compute that a request needs
evidence.quote: Neurons are our way of measuring AI outputs across different models, representing the GPU compute needed to perform your request.

reason: the note named the vocabulary instead of describing the unit; it now says what a Neuron is, what the page prices one model at, and that prepaid AI Gateway credits are a separate payment route

evidence.proved: the page prices bge-reranker-base at 283 neurons per million input tokens
evidence.quote: | @cf/baai/bge-reranker-base | $0.003 per M input tokens | 283 neurons per M input tokens |

evidence.proved: the daily free allocation of 10,000 neurons is an account-level limit: spending it answers HTTP 429 with internal code 3036, named Account limited
evidence.quote: | Account limited | `3036` | `429` | You have used up your daily free allocation of 10,000 neurons. Please upgrade to Cloudflare's Workers Paid plan if you would like to continue usage. |

evidence.proved: each model's tokens, audio seconds or images map to Neurons, so a Neuron is one unit over several raw units
evidence.quote: Each model's core input format(s) (tokens, audio seconds, images, etc) now include mappings to Neurons, making it easier to understand how your included Neuron volume is consumed and how you are charged at scale

evidence.proved: prepaid AI Gateway credits can pay for Workers AI inference, a payment route apart from the Neuron allocation
evidence.quote: Workers AI requests routed through that gateway deduct from your prepaid credit balance in real time.

evidence.proved: Workers Free carries 10,000 Neurons a day; usage beyond it needs an upgrade to Workers Paid
evidence.quote: | Workers Free | 10,000 Neurons per day | N/A - Upgrade to Workers Paid |
